We will contain burned fragments as each part comes down and collect sharp hardware separately from ordinary loose debris. A bracket embedded in damaged wall material may require controlled wall access instead of being pried against retained backsplash tile.

sections.title: Clean the exposed footprint for damage review
sections.text: Loose residue at the wall and floor is collected after the larger pieces leave. The revealed attachment area is available for heat-damage and support evaluation. Soot cleaning of retained finishes, electrical service and replacement-shelf installation remain distinct work after debris removal.

fire-damaged-debris-removal/murphy.estimate: Shelf weight, attachment, appliance handling and surrounding finish damage affect removal. Share safe photographs and service restrictions.
checklist: Identify the shelf and appliance it supports.
Describe brackets and damaged wall finishes.
Share disconnection and site-release information.

fire-damaged-contents-cleaning/murphy.intro: Fire damaged contents cleaning in Murphy can involve soot on a child’s hard plastic play table with removable legs and a recessed activity top. We will assess the item’s materials and heat exposure before proposing cleaning of surfaces a child will touch.

sections.title: Fire damaged contents cleaning in Murphy: inspect joints and heat damage before recovery
sections.text: The contents plan identifies the item and any loose toys separately. We will look for warping, cracks and softened plastic that can make replacement appropriate. The manufacturer’s care information and the intended use guide whether the remaining construction is suitable for treatment.

sections.title: Clean released parts and reachable recesses
sections.text: Accepted removable legs and inserts are separated using their intended releases. Loose soot is collected before compatible cleaning of the top, underside and exposed sockets, keeping dirty solution out of closed cavities. An enclosed hollow piece that admitted residue and cannot be reached receives a replacement decision rather than an exterior-only cleaning claim.

sections.title: Inspect dry parts before reassembly
sections.text: The cleaned surfaces and joints are checked for retained residue and material damage after drying. Unresolved odor or residue prompts further evaluation instead of return based on appearance. Reassembly and the item’s continued suitability for its intended use are reviewed separately from cleaning loose toys or other contents.

fire-damaged-contents-cleaning/murphy.estimate: Plastic condition, removable parts, closed cavities and manufacturer guidance affect recovery. Share photographs and any heat or suppression exposure.
checklist: Identify removable inserts and legs.
Describe cracks, distortion or hollow parts.
List loose items requiring separate decisions.

fire-extinguisher-residue-cleanup/murphy.intro: Fire extinguisher residue cleanup in Murphy can involve dry powder on a refrigerator door seal and in its folds after a kitchen discharge. We will identify the agent and separate accessible exterior cleaning from food-contact and internal appliance decisions.

sections.title: Fire extinguisher residue cleanup in Murphy: identify the agent and affected door surfaces
sections.text: The extinguisher information and appliance guidance determine the method. Food and exposed contents receive separate decisions before the door is repeatedly opened. The appliance provider controls any required isolation and disassembly, particularly where the seal conceals wiring or heated components.

sections.title: Collect deposits before flexing the seal repeatedly
sections.text: For an accepted dry agent, suitable filtered collection removes reachable loose powder from the gasket folds. We will gently expose permitted folds and use a compatible follow-up method without packing residue behind the seal or flooding its attachment. A split, distorted or inseparable contaminated gasket needs an appliance-provider replacement decision.

sections.title: Check the receiving edge before closing the door
sections.text: The adjoining door surface and reachable seal contact are inspected and cleaned within scope, then appropriately dried. Residue inside inaccessible door parts or food compartments requires a defined further evaluation. A clean gasket does not establish that the appliance, its food or internal components are ready for use.

fire-extinguisher-residue-cleanup/murphy.estimate: Agent type, seal construction, contamination extent and appliance access affect cleanup. Share the label and refrigerator model.
checklist: Provide the extinguisher agent information.
Identify residue in the gasket folds or interior.
Share appliance guidance and contents already removed.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/murphy.intro: Emergency board up after fire in Murphy can involve broken glazing within an exterior door that must remain available for authorized access. We will evaluate whether the door itself is sound enough to retain and fit temporary coverage without obstructing its hardware or required movement.

sections.title: Emergency board up after fire in Murphy: evaluate the door leaf before covering the glazing
sections.text: Site release and safe glass handling come first. The glazing provider identifies loose fragments and the condition of the glazing surround, while the door’s hinges, frame and latch are evaluated separately. A damaged leaf cannot be treated as a reliable carrier for a temporary panel simply because it still hangs in the opening.

sections.title: Fit coverage within the supported door arrangement
sections.text: After approved loose-glass removal, we will measure the exposed glazing area and arrange suitable attachment to sound material. Panel edges and fasteners are positioned clear of the latch, handle and moving clearances. If that arrangement cannot retain secure coverage and required door function, a different temporary closure and access plan is needed.

sections.title: Check coverage through the permitted movement
sections.text: The supported door is checked for panel interference and secure attachment during the agreed use. Required exit arrangements and authorized entry remain part of the temporary plan. Permanent glazing, door repair and any fire-rating requirements are handled by the responsible replacement provider.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/murphy.estimate: Glazing dimensions, door condition, hardware clearance and required access affect coverage. Share safe photographs and site restrictions.
checklist: Identify broken glazing within the door.
Describe hinge, frame or latch damage.
State required exit and authorized entry needs.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/murphy.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Murphy can involve wastewater deposited on a removable crawl-space ladder and the ground beneath it. We will establish supported access, recover the waste and assess the ladder’s individual materials before it becomes the clean carrying route.

sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Murphy: arrange access before releasing the ladder
sections.text: Source control, safe entry and the ladder’s attachment are evaluated first. We will arrange an approved alternate access or supported work sequence before a needed ladder is detached. Contaminated rungs are not used to carry cleaned equipment through the opening while their treatment remains pending.

sections.title: Reach rung contacts and the ground footprint
sections.text: Reachable wastewater and loose waste are collected before included ladder handling. Specified unsuitable porous pads or wooden components are contained for disposal, while suitable retained hard rails and rungs receive physical cleaning followed by the selected label-directed disinfection. Closed tubes or joints that admitted sewage but cannot be accessed need a replacement decision.

sections.title: Return access only after the contacts are resolved
sections.text: The exposed ground receives its own evaluated soil or liner disposition; cleaning the ladder does not resolve that footprint. Retained building surfaces receive drying where needed, and the access provider verifies attachment and condition before reuse. The accepted ladder returns through the clean route after the included contact surfaces have been addressed.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/murphy.estimate: Ladder attachment, materials, alternate access and ground contamination affect handling. Share safe existing photographs and source-repair findings.
checklist: Identify the ladder and its attachment.
Describe affected rungs, pads or hollow parts.
Share alternate access and sewage-source information.
